clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, Christoph Jeffcoat supplies the Forsaken with goods for trade and travel. His wares help crafters and travelers in Hillsbrad Foothills, where the Alliance and the Syndicate contest the land.

Christoph Jeffcoat tends to the practical needs of Tarren Mill, the Forsaken stronghold in Hillsbrad Foothills. He sells reagents, tools, threads, and spices to soldiers and traveling artisans. His goods include the spices used in turtle bisque, rare schematics, and alchemical vials. Horde forces passing through southern Lordaeron rely on such supplies as they face Southshore and the dangers of the region.
